XMLDB.COMMENT: Airpay Organization Engine — replaces BizLMS local_costcenter

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary key — matches original costcenter IDs after migration

FIELD.NAME: parentid
FIELD.COMMENT: Parent org ID (0 for root tenants)

FIELD.NAME: path
FIELD.COMMENT: Hierarchical path e.g. /1/2/3 — matches user.open_path segments

FIELD.NAME: org_logo
FIELD.COMMENT: File item ID for org logo (replaces costcenter_logo)

FIELD.NAME: brand_color
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary brand colour hex for this org

FIELD.NAME: favicon
FIELD.COMMENT: File item ID for the tenant favicon (upgrade 2026051100; in install.xml since 2026-09-03 so fresh installs match)

FIELD.NAME: hero_title
FIELD.COMMENT: Landing-page hero title for the tenant

FIELD.NAME: hero_subtitle
FIELD.COMMENT: Landing-page hero subtitle for the tenant

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_cohort_scope
TABLE.COMMENT: Tenant scope of a core cohort: the satellite row BizLMS kept in local_groups. One row per cohort. Filled by the BizLMS import (ADR-032, feature cohort_scope) and by nothing else yet; no reader shows it.

FIELD.NAME: cohortid
FIELD.COMMENT: cohort.id of the cohort this row scopes (core cohort table, id kept by the restored database)

FIELD.NAME: open_path
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant path of the cohort, for example /1/5 (a normalised path whose root is a registered tenant). NULL = no tenant path: visible to cross-tenant callers only

FIELD.NAME: departmentids
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma list of department (organisation) ids the cohort was offered to, for example 5,12. NULL = none

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Id of the user who last changed the scope (an actor reference, declared in the privacy provider). 0 = unknown or erased

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: When the scope was last changed (the local_groups value for imported rows)

INDEX.NAME: idx_open_path
INDEX.COMMENT: Tenant filtering: equality and boundary-bounded descendant matches
